title: Online Zikr (After Isha)
instructions: Open Paltalk and choose All Rooms, then Religion & Spirituality, then Islam, and join the room named "OURSHEIKH". The evening session begins after the Isha prayer in Pakistan; 9:15 pm Pakistan time and the 30-minute duration shown here are approximate and vary through the year.
availabilityNote: Room is visible only while a session is in progress. The start time follows the Isha prayer in Pakistan and may vary.

title: Online Zikr (Tahajjud)
instructions: Open Paltalk and choose All Rooms, then Religion & Spirituality, then Islam, and join the room named "OURSHEIKH". The Tahajjud session time varies; 3:30 am Pakistan time and the 30-minute duration shown here are approximate. Please check naqshbandiaowaisiah.org for current timings.
availabilityNote: Room is visible only while a session is in progress.
